text:
ana: quick note — we keep seeing opaque fallbacks during quota bursts. operators can't tell if rollback will make it worse or better :confused:

mike: yup, visibility gap. idea: show a small "rollback threshold" and recent trigger history on the operator panel :eyes:

sasha: i'd rather we give operators an explicit temp-override action that creates an auditable server-side override, not just a client toggle. audit trail is critical :lock:

quentin: agree with sasha. also need machine-readable reason codes on fallback events so automation can act. telemetry team, FYI.

dev-bot: deploy scheduled: autofallback-override-api -> staging @ 09:10 UTC

ana: (typo) ana: sample API sketch i threw together:

```
POST /v1/rollouts/{rollout_id}/operator-override
{
  "reason": "quiet rollout bump",
  "duration_secs": 300,
  "rollback_threshold": 0.15
}
```

mike: nice. is rollback_threshold a fraction of baseline error rate? need definition in the spec. also: scope — per-route, per-customer?

sasha: scope should be per-route + optional tenant filter. retention: audit logs retained >= 90d by default.

quentin: UX note — override must be visible only in operator console, not the public customer dashboards. otherwise confusing support threads.

ana: telemetry breadcrumbs we should capture with override: trace id, top 10 request samples, error-class histogram, pre/post metrics snapshot. link them in the audit entry.

mike: server-side safety: auto-revert override if error rate increases above X or latency spikes Y% over baseline. otherwise ops could make things worse.

sasha: also limit concurrent overrides per-route (suggestion: 2) to avoid override spam. include TTL enforcement so stale overrides expire.

quentin: agree. API change needs: openapi update, SDK bump, docs page, and a console affordance.

ana: UX mock idea: a compact "Quiet Nudge" control — prefilled durations (5m/15m/1h), reason dropdown, and an "Explainability" accordion showing top error classes + sample requests. button disabled if safety check fails.

mike: +1 on prefilled presets. add a small one-click rollback preview that shows expected effect on traffic routing (estimate).

sasha: can we make the override create an incident-style ticket automatically that links to the audit entry? helps handoff.

dev-bot: ticket created: DPL-4219 (autofallback override tracking)

quentin: next steps: ana to push figma mock, mike to spec server-side safety limits, sasha to write audit schema, i'll coordinate docs + SDK.

ana: thanks — i'll post the mock by EOD and add a short experiment plan (how we'll measure whether overrides reduce unnecessary rollbacks). :thumbsup:
